about_the_game:
Story Overview:

Francis was once a devoted husband and a dedicated employee at a high-end beauty and lotion e-commerce company. But his life takes a tragic turn when he's falsely accused of stalking a model affiliated with his workplace. Fired without cause and dragged through the legal system by his former employer, Francis finds himself blacklisted from the industry. With his reputation shattered and no job prospects in sight, Francis must get creative to survive—and possibly clear his name. Will he rebuild his life through resilience and ingenuity, or spiral into despair? The choices are yours.


Gameplay Features:


Branching Narrative Paths

  • Shape Francis’s journey through meaningful choices.

  • Multiple storylines and dialogue options lead to varied outcomes and endings.

  • Replayability is at the heart of the game, with consequences that ripple through each decision.

Customization

  • Choose your character’s name and avatar to personalize your experience.

  • Change Francis’s appearance and style as you progress.

Map-Based Navigation

  • Explore a city map to access different locations like:

    • Law Office

    • Freelance hubs

    • Hotel & Bar

    • Beach & Cafe

    • Shopping District

  • Each location opens up new story paths, side quests, or income opportunities.

Stat Management

  • Manage core stats that affect your progress:

    • Reputation, Grace and Authority

    • Courage and Curiousity

    • Finances

  • Certain choices and locations impact these stats—maintaining balance is crucial to survival and success.

Smart Save System

  • Create custom save names to track different playthroughs.

  • Easily revisit and explore alternative outcomes.

Multiple Endings

  • Your actions determine how the story ends:

    • Will Francis reclaim his old life—or build something new from the ashes?

    • Will he find justice, or descend into the shadows of society?

Content Warning:

This game contains themes of wrongful accusations, job loss, and emotional stress. Player discretion is advised.

Ideal for Fans of:

  • Narrative-driven games

  • Life simulation and stat-based decision-making

  • Games with social commentary and morally gray choices
